items.title: 材料-KY擬斥117億元收購同業瑞商Cerdia 營運版圖延伸至四大洲
items.title_en: Materials‑KY Plans to Spend NT$11.7 billion to Acquire Peer Cerdia, Expanding Operations to Four Continents
paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)展現跨區域、多元化發展的強大企圖心，公司21日召開董事會，通過與黑石集團(Blackstone)旗下管理基金簽署協議，以材料-KY9.95%股權及2.14億美元現金，收購同業Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) 100%股權，收購總金額約為3.68億美元。完成收購後，材料-KY將進一步朝「跨洲布局、在地供應、全球協同」發展。
生產醋片及絲束的Cerdia成立於1912年，與材料-KY為同業，自2017年自母公司分割後，現由黑石集團旗下私募基金管理，材料-KY以總金額3.68億美元的100%股權收購案，包括增加發行9.95%股權進行交換，並加上現金2.14億美元，收購總金額約為3.68億美元。
目前股本9.89億元的材料-KY，在增加發行9.95%股權後，股本將增加為10.98億元，而材料-KY預計在2027年年初在取得相關官方核准後，將完成收購程序。材料-KY指出，本交易完成後，集團營運據點將跨越亞洲、歐洲、北美洲及南美洲。
Cerdia擁有逾百年纖維素材料製造經驗，並於德國設有研發中心。Cerdia員工約1100人，為全球前三大醋酸纖維絲束製造商之一。其產品應用於眼鏡、紡織、美妝及高性能濾材等領域，並拓展至電子、醫療及環保永續材料等新興應用。
Cerdia成立於1912年原本為羅地亞(Rhodia)旗下的 Acetow 部門，2017 年由美國黑石集團收購，並於 2019 年正式更名為 Cerdia。2022 年將全球總部從德國遷至瑞士巴塞爾。

材料-KY目前以中國生產基地供應全球市場，並透過製造效率、成本管理及垂直整合建立競爭優勢。Cerdia加入後，集團供應體系將分成兩套系統，Cerdia負責生產醋酸纖維絲束，材料-KY則負責生產紡織材料、眼鏡框、手機殼以及車用電池等原材料，進一步朝「跨洲布局、在地供應、全球協同」發展，提升生產調度、原料配置與客戶服務的彈性。面對關稅、物流及地緣政治變化，跨區域營運布局亦可望強化供應鏈韌性，縮短與客戶及市場的距離，並更即時掌握各區域需求。
材料-KY董事長王克璋表示，「對這次交易，是把兩家具備高度互補優勢的公司結合在一起。未來我們在主要市場都能有更貼近客戶的布局，也能讓生產、供應和服務更有彈性。雙方在技術、產品和區域布局上各有所長，結合之後，我們希望能用更完整的產品和更靈活的供應能力，服務全球不同市場的客戶。」
材料-KY表示，本次交易的現金對價規劃擬以自有資金支應。公司將在兼顧日常營運資金需求與財務結構下進行資金配置，並保留後續整合及成長所需的財務彈性。
材料-KY已在9月15日股東臨時會中通過修訂公司章程額定資本由目前10億元增至20億元。材料-KY大提高額定資本額至20億元，主要在於可能為進行擴張而進行的可能包括發行可轉債或發行現增股的籌資動作，而依目前估計，材料-KY最快的市場籌資措施，也要到2027年出現才會出現。
材料-KY 2026年第二季營收27.43億元 ，毛利率40.89%，季減14.69個百分點，年減17.34個百分點，稅後純益7.17億元，季減35.73%，年減57.92%，每股純益0.72元。累計上半年營收55.54億元，毛利率48.06%，年減10.28個百分點，上半年稅後純益18.31億元，年減5.95%，每股純益1.85元。
材料-KY在2026年8月營收10.4億元，月減1.7%，年增20.82%，2026年1-8月營收76.53億元，年減20.91%。材料-KY指出，公司持續深化新興市場布局，營運動能穩步回升。
paras_en: Materials‑KY (4763‑TW) demonstrated strong ambition for cross‑regional and diversified development. On the 21st, the board approved an agreement with a Blackstone‑managed fund to acquire 100% of peer Cerdia Holding (Cerdia) by issuing a 9.95% equity stake and paying US$214 million in cash, for a total consideration of about US$368 million. After the deal, Materials‑KY will further pursue a "cross‑continent footprint, local supply, global synergy" strategy.

Cerdia, which produces acetate sheets and yarn bundles, was founded in 1912 and is in the same industry as Materials‑KY. Since its spin‑off from its parent in 2017, it has been managed by a private‑equity fund under Blackstone. Materials‑KY’s US$368 million purchase includes a 9.95% equity issuance in exchange for shares plus US$214 million in cash.

Materials‑KY currently has a share capital of NT$9.89 billion. After issuing the additional 9.95% equity, share capital will rise to NT$10.98 billion. The company expects to complete the acquisition in early 2027 once the relevant regulatory approvals are obtained. Materials‑KY noted that, once the transaction is finished, its operating sites will span Asia, Europe, North America and South America.

Cerdia boasts more than a century of experience in cellulose material manufacturing and operates an R&D centre in Germany. With roughly 1,100 employees, it is one of the world’s top three producers of acetate filament yarn. Its products are used in eyewear, textiles, cosmetics and high‑performance filter media, and the company is expanding into emerging applications such as electronics, medical and sustainable environmental materials.

Cerdia was originally the Acetow division of Rhodia when it was founded in 1912. Blackstone acquired it in 2017, and the company was officially renamed Cerdia in 2019. In 2022, its global headquarters moved from Germany to Basel, Switzerland.

Materials‑KY currently supplies the global market from its production base in China, leveraging manufacturing efficiency, cost management and vertical integration for competitive advantage. After Cerdia joins, the group will operate two parallel supply systems: Cerdia will produce acetate filament yarn, while Materials‑KY will produce textile materials, eyewear frames, mobile‑phone cases and automotive‑battery raw materials. This structure supports the "cross‑continent footprint, local supply, global synergy" goal, enhancing flexibility in production scheduling, raw‑material allocation and customer service. Facing tariff, logistics and geopolitical shifts, a cross‑regional operating model is expected to strengthen supply‑chain resilience, shorten distances to customers and markets, and enable more timely response to regional demand.

Materials‑KY Chairman Wang Ke‑zhang said, "This transaction brings together two companies with highly complementary strengths. In the future we will have a closer presence to customers in our main markets, and our production, supply and service will be more flexible. Both sides have their own technical, product and regional advantages; by combining them we hope to offer a more complete product portfolio and more agile supply capability to serve customers worldwide."

Materials‑KY indicated that the cash consideration for the deal will be funded from its own resources. The company will allocate capital while balancing daily operating cash needs and its financial structure, preserving financial flexibility for subsequent integration and growth.

At the extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on September 15, Materials‑KY approved an amendment to increase its authorized capital from the current NT$10 billion to NT$20 billion. The substantial raise is intended to support potential expansion financing, such as issuing convertible bonds or a capital increase, with the earliest market‑raising actions not expected until 2027.

In Q2 2026, Materials‑KY reported revenue of NT$27.43 billion, a gross margin of 40.89% (down 14.69 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 17.34 points year‑over‑year), net profit after tax of NT$7.17 billion (down 35.73% QoQ and 57.92% YoY), and earnings per share of NT$0.72. For the first half of the year, cumulative revenue was NT$55.54 billion, gross margin 48.06% (down 10.28 points YoY), net profit NT$18.31 billion (down 5.95% YoY), and EPS NT$1.85.

In August 2026, Materials‑KY posted revenue of NT$10.4 billion, down 1.7% month‑over‑month but up 20.82% year‑over‑year. For the period January‑August 2026, revenue was NT$76.53 billion, down 20.91% YoY. The company said it continues to deepen its presence in emerging markets, with operating momentum steadily recovering.

items.title: Meta Muse帶旺CPU行情！AMD躋身兆美元俱樂部 英特爾、Arm跟著嗨
items.title_en: Meta Muse Boosts CPU Rally! AMD Joins the Trillion‑Dollar Club, Intel and Arm Follow Suit
paras: Meta平台(META-US) 推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也讓市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。
超微電腦(SMCI-US) 周一（21日）股價大漲近10%，收在615.52美元，市值首度突破1兆美元，成為繼輝達(NVDA-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 及美光科技(MU-US) 後，第4家跨越兆美元門檻的美國晶片公司。
AMD周一股價創6月30日以來收盤新高。自蘇姿丰2014年接掌公司以來，市值較2015年夏季低點翻逾370倍。
經歷前兩個月回檔後，AMD重新獲得投資人青睞，9月迄今上漲近30%，可望寫下5月以來最大單月漲幅。
這波漲勢的催化劑來自AI應用端。Meta於9月初推出Muse，可在後台代替使用者預訂旅行、管理行程及購物。
Sensor Tower數據顯示，Muse已連續3天位居美國iPhone免費App下載榜首，ChatGPT排名第2，Google Gemini居第8，Claude則降至第22。
Muse快速竄紅，使市場押注消費級智能體可能接近大規模普及的轉折點。隨著AI從問答走向實際操作，推論及基礎設施工作負載將增加，進而推升CPU需求。
Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6吉瓦的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1吉瓦部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。
樂觀情緒也蔓延至其他CPU概念股。英特爾(INTC-US) 周一大漲12.14%，Arm(ARM-US) 勁揚17.16%，高通上漲逾8%，Meta也飆升逾11%，創今年1月以來新高。
業者對伺服器CPU市場同樣看好。Arm預估2030年市場規模可達1,200億美元；AMD則上看2,200億美元。英特爾執行長陳立武上周也表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求，CPU供應緊張仍將持續。
paras_en: Meta's consumer‑grade AI agent Muse, launched on the META‑US platform, quickly went viral, prompting the market to reassess the compute demand from widespread AI agents and lifting all CPU‑related stocks.

Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) surged nearly 10% on Monday the 21st, closing at $615.52, and its market value broke the $1 trillion threshold for the first time, becoming the fourth U.S. chip company to cross that mark after Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

AMD’s share price hit a new closing high for the period since June 30 on Monday. Since Su Zifeng took the helm in 2014, the company’s market cap has multiplied more than 370 times from its summer‑2015 low.
After a pullback in the first two months, AMD has regained investor favor, up nearly 30% through September and poised to record its biggest monthly gain since May.
The catalyst for this rally comes from AI applications. Meta rolled out Muse in early September, allowing it to book travel, manage itineraries and shop on behalf of users in the background.
Sensor Tower data shows Muse has topped the U.S. iPhone free‑app download chart for three consecutive days, ranking ahead of ChatGPT (2nd), Google Gemini (8th) and Claude (down to 22nd).

Muse’s rapid rise has led the market to bet that consumer‑grade AI agents are nearing a mass‑adoption inflection point; as AI shifts from Q&A to real‑world tasks, inference and infrastructure workloads will grow, driving higher CPU demand.

Meta is currently AMD’s second‑largest customer, accounting for about 5.5% of revenue. The two firms announced an expanded partnership in February, with Meta planning to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, the first batch supporting 1 GW slated for shipment in the second half of 2026 and built on a custom chip based on the MI450 architecture.

Optimism spilled over to other CPU stocks. Intel (INTC‑US) jumped 12.14% on Monday, Arm (ARM‑US) surged 17.16%, Qualcomm rose over 8%, and Meta itself climbed more than 11%, hitting its highest level since January.

Industry players remain bullish on the server‑CPU market. Arm projects the market could reach $120 billion by 2030, AMD sees it topping $220 billion, and Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said last week the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand, with tight CPU supply expected to continue.

items.title: Muse超越ChatGPT登頂！Meta掀AI代理浪潮 超級App們準備投降？
items.title_en: Muse Surpasses ChatGPT to the Top! Meta Sparks AI Agent Wave—Will Super Apps Surrender?
paras: Meta(META-US) 個人AI助手Muse爆紅，誰又該要慌了？這背後代表著什麼趨勢，又有什麼機會？
具體來看，9 月 8 日發布的兩天後，Muse 在美國 App Store 的下載量就超過了 8 萬次，衝到總榜第二。第三方數據機構 Sensor Tower 統計則顯示，它上線第一週的下載量就接近 90 萬次。
又過了幾天，Muse 登上了美國 App Store 免費榜第一名，一度把 ChatGPT 擠下去。
但 Muse 值得關注的地方，是它「個人AI代理」的官方定位。也就是說，它並不是因為有多能聊天而受歡迎，是你交代一個目標，它能自己把事情辦完。
Muse 的登頂則表明，個人 AI代理正從產業概念真正走進大眾消費市場。這是一個非常強的早期信號，意味著大家願意把真實的任務交給 AI 去辦，有這個需求。
字節的豆包手機想讓 AI 像人一樣操作手機上的 App，替用戶把事辦成，結果卻卡在了超級 App 的權限限制上。這次，Muse 又走了另外一條路。那麼，超級 App 還能長期把 AI代理擋在門外？還是應該像 Meta 一樣，主動加入這場革命呢？
首先，Muse 的執行方式和手機廠商的做法不太一樣。豆包手機是讓 AI 去理解手機螢幕、操作一個個 App。但問題是，技術上能走通，商業上卻困難重重。
此外，蘋果、Google、小米等等各個公司也都給出了自己的解法。Muse 則是在雲端給每個用戶配了一台獨立的虛擬機，裡面有一個真正的瀏覽器，可以安全地儲存 AI代理的數據和已連接服務的憑證。
AI 就在這台雲端電腦裡完成瀏覽網頁、填寫表單、調用服務等各類任務。當涉及發送郵件或完成付款等敏感操作時，Muse 會先請求用戶批准。
當然，給 AI代理配一台雲端電腦，讓它自己在裡面完成任務，這件事本身並不新鮮。
此前，騰訊雲已經把雲桌面做成了 AI代理的運行基座，百度智慧雲也能一鍵部署 AI代理。OpenClaw、Hermes 這類 AI代理，早就能在雲端伺服器上長期運行。
Muse 只是把這件事工程化和產品化了，把過去只有極客、開發者尖端科技愛好者才願意費勁折騰的事情，打包成了普通消費者拿起手機就能用的產品。
這不是說它沒有技術含量。Meta 還需要在架構優化、安全隔離、敏感動作審批等方面花大量功夫，讓每個人都敢放心把真實任務交給 Muse 去做。
可見，豆包和 Muse，兩條路線沒有誰先進誰落後，但它們共同說明了一件事，即 AI代理這個潮流不會因為超級 App 的圍堵而停止。
原因也很簡單，AI代理不只有一種做法。手機跨 App 操作的這條路，可能容易被超級 App 通過權限的封鎖而堵住，但 AI代理還可以走網頁的路。
網頁和平台並不是不封網頁端的 AI代理。去年，亞馬遜就明確要求 Perplexity 的瀏覽器 AI代理 Comet，停止在亞馬遜的網站上代理購物。理由是第三方 AI代理會破壞亞馬遜為用戶提供的完整購物體驗。
就在封別人 AI代理的同時，亞馬遜卻在緊鑼密鼓地大力發展購物 AI代理。Buy for Me 功能，就是讓亞馬遜的 AI代理直接跑到其他品牌網站上替用戶下單，用戶在自己的亞馬遜帳號裡完成一整套購買流程。目前，該功能已經涵蓋了數千萬種商品。
因此，做 AI代理已經是共識，產業競爭的焦點只是誰能控制 AI代理入口。這點在 Meta 做 Muse 這件事上看得最清楚。
理論上，Muse 就是在革 Meta 的命。因為用戶習慣了 AI代理，就不再自己打開 App 去搜索、瀏覽和比較，而是會直接把目標告訴 AI，剩下的交給 AI 去處理。但這跟 Meta 賴以為生的廣告模式有直接衝突。人們都不點開 Meta 的 App 和網頁了，廣告給誰看呢？
可要知道，今天的 Meta 還高度依賴廣告。2026 年第二季度，他們的廣告收入為 593 億美元，佔總收入的 97%。也就是說，Meta 在舊模式還極其賺錢的時候，主動開啟了可能顛覆自己舊模式的個人 AI代理業務。
Meta 認定一場產業革命要來，就主動革了自己的命，不因為新模式可能損害舊利益，就拒絕進入，或是緩慢推進。而且，他們的轉型也並不是莽撞的行為。
Meta 手裡握著超 30 億的日活用戶，一旦通過這個基本盤佔住了個人AI代理這個新入口，也就將成為 AI代理時代最強的玩家之一。
AI代理真正會帶來的變化，就是超級App主導的產業格局終將被打破。超級 App 未必會消失，但它們將逐漸從第一入口，變成 AI代理背後的服務提供者。
未來用戶一定會越來越習慣先把需求交給 AI代理，再由 AI代理去尋找和調用服務。可以說，這是繼 iPhone之後，手機產業最令人興奮的趨勢，也是我們認為，所有開發者和創業者最應該參與的機會。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) personal AI assistant Muse has gone viral—who should be worried? What trend does this represent, and what opportunities does it bring?

Specifically, just two days after its September 8 launch, Muse topped 80,000 downloads on the US App Store, climbing to second place overall. Third‑party data firm Sensor Tower reports that its first week of availability drew nearly 900,000 downloads.
A few days later, Muse reached the number‑one spot on the US App Store free chart, briefly displacing ChatGPT.

What’s noteworthy about Muse is its official positioning as a “personal AI agent.” In other words, its popularity isn’t just because it can chat—it can be given a goal and complete the task on its own.

Muse’s ascent shows that personal AI agents are moving from an industry concept into the mass‑consumer market. This is a strong early signal that people are willing to hand real tasks over to AI, indicating genuine demand.

ByteDance’s Doubao phone aims to let AI operate apps on the phone like a human and complete tasks for users, but it’s stalled by super‑app permission limits. Muse, however, has taken a different route. So can super apps keep AI agents out in the long run, or should they, like Meta, join the revolution?
First, Muse’s execution differs from phone‑maker approaches. Doubao lets AI interpret the screen and manipulate each app, a technically feasible but commercially challenging method.

Moreover, Apple, Google, Xiaomi and others have each offered their own solutions. Muse instead provisions each user with a dedicated cloud VM that runs a real browser, safely storing the agent’s data and credentials for connected services.

The AI performs web browsing, form‑filling, service calls and other tasks inside that cloud computer. For sensitive actions such as sending email or making payments, Muse first asks the user for approval.
Providing an AI agent with its own cloud computer to carry out tasks isn’t a new idea in itself.

Previously, Tencent Cloud turned its cloud desktops into AI‑agent platforms, and Baidu Smart Cloud can deploy AI agents with a single click. Projects like OpenClaw and Hermes have long run AI agents on cloud servers.
Muse simply engineers and productizes this concept, turning what was once a niche, geek‑level undertaking into a consumer‑ready product you can use on a phone with a tap.

That doesn’t mean it lacks technical depth. Meta still has to invest heavily in architecture optimization, security isolation, and approval flows for sensitive actions so users feel comfortable entrusting real tasks to Muse.
Thus, Doubao and Muse follow different paths without one being inherently ahead, yet both demonstrate that the AI‑agent wave won’t be halted by super‑app gatekeeping.
The reason is simple: AI agents can be implemented in multiple ways. The cross‑app mobile route may be blocked by super‑app permission restrictions, but agents can also operate via the web.

Web‑based agents aren’t prohibited either. Last year Amazon explicitly told Perplexity’s browser AI agent Comet to stop acting as a shopping assistant on Amazon’s site, arguing third‑party agents undermine Amazon’s curated shopping experience.

At the same time Amazon is aggressively building its own shopping AI agents. Its “Buy for Me” feature lets Amazon’s AI place orders on other brands’ sites on behalf of users, completing the entire purchase within the user’s Amazon account. The feature now covers tens of millions of products.
Consequently, building AI agents has become a consensus, and industry competition now centers on who controls the entry point for those agents—a point made crystal clear by Meta’s launch of Muse.

In theory, Muse could rewrite Meta’s destiny. As users grow accustomed to AI agents, they’ll stop opening apps to search, browse and compare, instead telling the AI what they want and letting it handle the rest. That directly conflicts with Meta’s ad‑driven business model—if people no longer open Meta’s apps or sites, who sees the ads?

It’s worth noting that Meta remains heavily ad‑dependent today. In Q2 2026, its ad revenue was $59.3 billion, accounting for 97% of total revenue. In other words, while its legacy model is still extremely profitable, Meta has proactively launched a personal AI‑agent business that could disrupt that very model.

Meta believes an industry revolution is coming, so it’s reshaping its own fate rather than shying away from a new model that might erode existing profits or moving slowly. Moreover, its transformation isn’t reckless.
Meta controls over 3 billion daily active users; once it secures the personal AI‑agent entry point with that base, it will become one of the strongest players in the AI‑agent era.

The real impact of AI agents will be to break the super‑app‑dominated industry structure. Super apps may not disappear, but they will shift from being the primary entry point to becoming service providers behind AI agents.

In the future, users will increasingly hand their needs to AI agents first, which will then locate and invoke the appropriate services. This can be seen as the most exciting post‑iPhone trend in the mobile industry—and, in our view, the biggest opportunity for developers and entrepreneurs.

items.title: Meta Muse登上App Store榜首 AMD市值首破1兆美元
items.title_en: Meta's Muse Tops App Store; AMD Market Value Breaks $1 Trillion
paras: Meta Platforms (META-US)旗下AI代理人Muse登上美國Apple (AAPL-US) App Store免費應用程式下載榜首, 市場開始將這項消費端AI應用的快速普及, 視為AI代理人需求可能擴大以及伺服器CPU需求升溫的新訊號, 帶動Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US)股價21日大漲9.9%, 市值首度突破1兆美元。
AMD當日收於615.52美元, 上漲55.70美元或9.95%, 盤中一度觸及616.69美元歷史新高。以公司最新申報的流通股數計算, AMD市值突破1兆美元, 成為美國第4家市值達到這一門檻的晶片公司, 其他包括NVIDIA (NVDA-US)、Broadcom (AVGO-US)及Micron Technology (MU-US)。
這波漲勢的直接催化劑是Muse。Sensor Tower數據顯示, Muse已連續3天成為美國iPhone免費App下載量最高的應用程式。不同於傳統聊天機器人主要提供問答, AI代理人可以按照使用者指令執行多步驟任務, 包括瀏覽網頁、處理資料、執行程式以及其他需要持續運算的工作。
市場之所以將Muse的走紅與AMD連結, 關鍵在於AI代理人的運作方式。AI代理人在執行任務時, 除了需要AI加速器處理模型推論, 還需要大量中央處理器(CPU)負責工具呼叫、任務協調以及不同模型運算之間的流程控制。AMD長期布局的EPYC伺服器CPU因此可能從AI代理人需求擴張中受益。
AMD執行長蘇姿丰在第2季財報電話會議上表示, 公司目前預期伺服器CPU市場到2030年將以超過50%的速度成長, 總可服務市場(TAM)約達2,200億美元。她並指出, 在這2,200億美元市場中, agentic AI或AI sandbox將成為最大的一部分, 同時也是成長速度最快、目前規模最小的部分。
AMD第2季業績也為市場重新評估CPU在AI基礎設施中的角色提供支撐。截至6月27日的第2季, AMD營收年增50%至115億美元, 非GAAP稀釋後每股盈餘則年增246%至1.66美元。資料中心營收更年增107%, 達67億美元, 超過1年前的1倍。
AMD也同步提高對資料中心市場的預期。公司目前預估, 資料中心AI加速器市場到2030年將以超過45%的年增率擴張至約1.4兆美元, 而伺服器CPU市場則預估以超過50%的年增率成長至約2,200億美元。公司並預期2026年下半年伺服器營收將年增超過80%, 2027年全年則將年增超過70%; 資料中心部門2027年營收則預期將超過2026年的2倍。
除了AMD之外, AI代理人帶動的CPU需求預期也推升其他晶片股。Arm Holdings (ARM-US)21日股價大漲約17%, Intel (INTC-US)上漲約12%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US)上漲約9%, VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US)則上漲約4.3%。Reuters指出, 晶片股大漲也推動費城半導體指數上升4.3%。
Intel的漲勢尤其受到市場對伺服器CPU需求升溫的預期帶動。市場對AI基礎設施的關注過去主要集中在GPU及其他AI加速器, 但AI代理人需要大量CPU處理周邊工作, 使投資人重新關注CPU在下一階段AI運算架構中的角色。
Meta本身也是AMD的重要客戶。兩家公司今年2月擴大合作, 規劃在Meta的資料中心基礎設施中部署AMD的AI晶片, 涵蓋最高6GW的電力容量。這意味著Muse帶動的AI代理人需求, 不只是市場對AMD長期CPU市場預測的抽象想像, AMD與Meta之間本身已存在直接的商業合作關係。
Meta股價同樣受到Muse市場反應帶動。Meta 21日收於741.25美元, 上漲75.50美元或11.34%, 盤中一度升至753美元, 市值達約1.89兆美元。Reuters指出, Meta股價大漲同時受到市場對Muse的樂觀情緒以及券商調升目標價等因素推動。
AI代理人能否真正帶動CPU需求, 仍取決於未來企業與消費者的實際使用方式。AI代理人需要持續執行任務, 因此會增加CPU負載, 但模型推論本身仍高度依賴GPU等AI加速器, 實際增加多少CPU需求也會受到資料中心架構、工作負載配置及運算效率影響。因此,Muse登上App Store榜首目前更適合作為消費端AI代理人開始獲得大規模採用的市場訊號, 而非直接等同於AMD未來營收的增加。
不過, Muse的下載排名仍提供了一項此前較少見的消費端數據。AMD過去提出的AI代理人市場論述主要建立在企業及資料中心工作負載預期之上, 如今Meta的AI代理人進入美國iPhone免費App下載榜首, 顯示AI代理人開始從企業工具擴展至一般消費者市場。市場因此重新評估CPU在AI產業下一階段成長中的角色。
在更廣泛的市場層面, AI題材也重新推動科技股走高。Nasdaq綜合指數21日上漲逾2%, 創下自6月以來首個歷史收盤新高; S&P 500上漲1.49%, 道瓊工業指數上漲0.71%。AI相關晶片股成為盤面主要推動力量之一。
AMD突破1兆美元市值, 也代表市場對AI基礎設施的投資邏輯正在從單純追逐AI加速器, 擴大至CPU、記憶體、網路及其他資料中心零組件。隨著AI代理人需要持續執行更多複雜任務, CPU能否成為下一階段AI基礎設施需求的重要受益者, 將成為晶片產業接下來的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) AI agent Muse has risen to the top of the free‑app download chart on Apple’s (AAPL-US) US App Store, prompting the market to view the rapid consumer‑side adoption of this AI agent as a new signal that demand for AI agents – and consequently server CPU demand – could expand, sending Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) shares up 9.9% on the 21st and pushing its market value past the $1 trillion mark for the first time.

AMD closed the day at $615.52, up $55.70 or 9.95%, briefly hitting a historic intraday high of $616.69. Based on the company’s latest reported share count, AMD’s market cap has broken the $1 trillion threshold, making it the fourth U.S. chip firm to reach that level after NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

The immediate catalyst for the rally is Muse. Sensor Tower data show that Muse has been the most downloaded free iPhone app in the United States for three consecutive days. Unlike traditional chatbots that mainly answer questions, AI agents can follow user commands to perform multi‑step tasks such as browsing the web, processing data, running programs and other workloads that require continuous computation.

The market links Muse’s popularity to AMD because of how AI agents operate. When an AI agent runs a task it not only needs an AI accelerator for model inference, but also a large amount of central processing unit (CPU) power to handle tool calls, task coordination and flow control between different model computations. AMD’s long‑standing EPYC server CPUs could therefore benefit from expanding AI‑agent demand.

AMD CEO Dr. Lisa Su said in the Q2 earnings call that the company now expects the server‑CPU market to grow at a rate of more than 50% through 2030, with a total addressable market of roughly $220 billion. She noted that within that $220 billion market, agentic AI or AI sandboxes will become the largest segment, as well as the fastest‑growing and currently smallest portion.

AMD’s Q2 results also gave the market fresh support for reassessing the role of CPUs in AI infrastructure. For the quarter ended June 27, AMD’s revenue rose 50% year‑over‑year to $11.5 billion, and non‑GAAP diluted EPS jumped 246% to $1.66. Data‑center revenue surged 107% year‑over‑year to $6.7 billion, more than double the level a year earlier.

AMD also raised its outlook for the data‑center market. The company now projects the AI‑accelerator market for data centers to expand at a compound annual growth rate of over 45% to about $1.4 trillion by 2030, while the server‑CPU market is expected to grow at over 50% CAGR to roughly $220 billion. AMD foresees server revenue growing more than 80% year‑over‑year in the second half of 2026 and more than 70% for all of 2027; data‑center revenue in 2027 is expected to exceed 2026’s level by more than double.

Beyond AMD, the CPU demand driven by AI agents is also lifting other chip stocks. Arm Holdings (ARM‑US) jumped about 17% on the 21st, Intel (INTC‑US) rose roughly 12%, Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) about 9% and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) about 4.3%. Reuters noted that the broad rally in chip stocks pushed the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 4.3%.

Intel’s gains were especially fueled by market expectations of hotter server‑CPU demand. While attention to AI infrastructure has traditionally focused on GPUs and other accelerators, AI agents require substantial CPU work for peripheral tasks, prompting investors to re‑evaluate the CPU’s role in the next‑generation AI compute stack.

Meta itself is an important AMD customer. The two companies expanded their partnership in February, planning to deploy AMD AI chips in Meta’s data‑center infrastructure with up to 6 GW of power capacity. This means that the demand for AI agents spurred by Muse is not just an abstract long‑term CPU forecast – there is already a direct commercial relationship between AMD and Meta.

Meta’s stock also reacted to the Muse buzz. Meta closed on the 21st at $741.25, up $75.50 or 11.34%, briefly reaching $753 intraday, giving it a market cap of about $1.89 trillion. Reuters said the surge was driven by optimism around Muse as well as broker upgrades to price targets.

Whether AI agents can truly drive CPU demand will depend on how enterprises and consumers actually use them. Agents run continuously, which adds CPU load, but model inference still heavily relies on GPUs and other accelerators. The net increase in CPU demand will vary with data‑center architecture, workload mix and compute efficiency. Thus, Muse’s topping the App Store is currently a better signal that consumer‑side AI agents are beginning to achieve mass adoption, rather than a direct proxy for AMD’s future revenue growth.

Nevertheless, Muse’s download ranking provides a rare consumer‑side data point. AMD’s earlier AI‑agent market thesis was built mainly on enterprise and data‑center workload expectations; now that Meta’s AI agent has reached the top of the U.S. iPhone free‑app chart, it shows agents are moving from enterprise tools into the broader consumer market, prompting a reassessment of the CPU’s role in the next phase of AI industry growth.

On a broader market level, AI themes are once again lifting tech stocks. The Nasdaq Composite rose more than 2% on the 21st, hitting its first closing high since June, while the S&P 500 gained 1.49% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.71%. AI‑related chip stocks were among the main drivers of the rally.

AMD’s breach of the $1 trillion market‑cap mark also reflects a shift in investment logic for AI infrastructure, expanding from a sole focus on AI accelerators to include CPUs, memory, networking and other data‑center components. As AI agents require more continuous, complex task execution, whether CPUs become a major beneficiary of the next wave of AI infrastructure demand will be a key focus for the chip industry going forward.

items.title: AI「殺手級應用」出現了？Meta Muse快速爆紅 亞馬遜為何封鎖？
items.title_en: Has a "killer" AI application finally emerged? Meta's Muse skyrockets while Amazon blocks it
paras: Meta(META-US)旗下AI智慧代理應用Muse上線不到兩週，已在下載量和日活用戶數兩項關鍵指標上超越ChatGPT同期表現，引發市場對AI代理能否真正走向大眾的強烈期待。
Muse上線僅約五天便錄得73萬次下載，累計下載量在12天內突破280萬次，並於上週五登頂美國iOS免費應用榜首，超越ChatGPT、Anthropic的Claude及SpaceX AI旗下的Grok。受此提振，Meta股價週一單日飆漲逾11%，富國銀行隨即將其目標價上調至796美元。
市場分析人士認為，Muse的爆發式增長標誌著AI代理應用正從開發者和技術愛好者群體向普通消費者加速滲透。據CNBC報導，Bernstein分析師Stacy Rasgon表示：「到目前為止，大多數代理類應用場景並非真正面向普通人。現在Meta Muse等代理應用開始出現，或許正在獲得更廣泛普及的潛力。」
據TechCrunch報導，市場情報機構Apptopia的數據顯示，在可進行同口徑比較的美國和加拿大市場，Muse上線首12天的iOS下載量達180萬次，高於ChatGPT同期的130萬次。
另一家分析機構Sensor Tower數據則顯示，Muse在上線約五天內錄得73萬次下載，截至週一累計下載量已超過250萬次，其中iOS和Android平台分別貢獻約150萬次和,110萬次。
相比之下，Claude和Grok在同等13天窗口期內的下載量分別為40萬次和20萬次。ChatGPT在同一時間窗口內錄得310萬次下載，仍領先於Muse，但需注意兩款應用的平台發布策略存在差異——ChatGPT當年僅在iOS全球上線，而Muse目前僅在美國和加拿大的iOS及Android雙平台發布。
日活用戶數據同樣亮眼。Apptopia數據顯示，Muse的美國移動端日活用戶已達64.2萬，遠高於ChatGPT同期的23.1萬；即便僅比較iOS平台，Muse的日活用戶也以35.9萬對ChatGPT形成超越。
Meta將Muse定位為面向普通消費者的AI智慧代理工具，核心功能包括跨網絡執行任務，如填寫電子表單、整理電子郵件收件箱等，旨在讓用戶能夠管理和調度功能強大的數字助手。該應用由Meta的Muse Spark系列AI模型驅動，是首席執行官扎克伯格大舉進軍AI代理市場的重要舉措。
在商業模式上，Muse提供免費基礎版，同時設有每月20美元和100美元兩檔訂閱方案，為Meta開闢了一條有別於核心在線廣告業務的AI變現路徑。
Meta在用戶導流方面具備顯著的平台優勢。據Apptopia數據，Muse用戶中逾95%同時是Facebook用戶，63%是Instagram用戶。Muse還支持與WhatsApp打通，Meta此前憑藉類似的跨平台導流策略將Threads推向5億用戶規模，Muse有望複製這路徑。
Muse的快速擴張已在電商領域引發明顯的生態摩擦。亞馬遜宣布封鎖Muse對其購物網站的訪問，理由是隱私和安全風險。亞馬遜方面表示，Meta事先未告知Muse將訪問其平台，並指出該代理繞過了亞馬遜購物體驗中內置的個性化功能，且疑似捕獲並記憶體用戶憑證、抓取帳戶數據。
亞馬遜發言人在聲明中表示，「我們認為，代表客戶在其他商家處進行購買的第三方應用，應當公開透明進行，並尊重服務提供商關於是否參與的決定。」
與此形成對比的是，Shopify選擇與Meta合作。Shopify執行長Tobias Lütke週一宣布，Shopify將與Muse合作，允許其在平台商店內實現代理結帳功能，雙方的合作為Muse在電商場景的落地提供了重要背書。
儘管Muse開局強勁，但市場對其能否維持熱度仍存疑慮。此前，OpenAI的Sora以及Meta自身的Vibes AI視頻工具均曾在發布初期引發下載熱潮，但未能持續成為現象級產品。
同時，Muse的崛起也面臨更廣泛的行業背景壓力。AI安全與網絡安全風險的擔憂近期持續困擾科技行業，而Meta本身也剛剛同意支付約170億美元，與多個州檢察長就Facebook和Instagram對兒童及青少年造成潛在傷害的指控達成和解。
Muse對用戶個人數據的高度依賴同樣引發關注。Stacy Rasgon指出：「他們（用戶）在意安全，但我不確定他們有多在意隱私。」這一問題或將成為Muse長期發展的潛在隱患。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) launched its AI smart agent app Muse less than two weeks ago, and it has already surpassed ChatGPT’s performance at the same stage in both download volume and daily active users, sparking strong market expectations about whether AI agents can truly go mainstream.

Within about five days of launch, Muse recorded 730,000 downloads, and its cumulative downloads topped 2.8 million within 12 days, reaching the top of the U.S. iOS free‑app chart last Friday, ahead of ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude and SpaceX AI’s Grok. Boosted by this, Meta’s stock surged more than 11% on Monday, and Wells Fargo immediately raised its target price to $796.

Market analysts say Muse’s explosive growth marks AI agents moving from developers and tech enthusiasts to ordinary consumers. According to CNBC, Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon said, “So far most agent‑type use cases haven’t really been aimed at the average person. Now apps like Meta Muse are appearing and may have broader adoption potential.”

TechCrunch reported that market‑intelligence firm Apptopia’s data show that in the comparable U.S. and Canada markets, Muse’s iOS downloads in its first 12 days reached 1.8 million, higher than ChatGPT’s 1.3 million in the same period.

Data from another analytics firm, Sensor Tower, show that Muse logged 730,000 downloads in roughly five days after launch and had exceeded 2.5 million cumulative downloads by Monday, with about 1.5 million on iOS and 1.1 million on Android.

By contrast, Claude and Grok recorded 400,000 and 200,000 downloads respectively over the same 13‑day window. ChatGPT logged 3.1 million downloads in that period, still ahead of Muse, but note the platforms differ—ChatGPT was only on iOS globally at the time, whereas Muse is currently released on both iOS and Android in the U.S. and Canada.

Daily active user numbers are equally impressive. Apptopia data show Muse’s U.S. mobile daily active users reached 642,000, far above ChatGPT’s 231,000 in the same timeframe; even on iOS alone, Muse’s daily active users of 359,000 outpaced ChatGPT.

Meta positions Muse as an AI smart‑agent tool for everyday consumers, with core functions that execute cross‑network tasks such as filling out online forms and organizing email inboxes, aiming to let users manage and schedule a powerful digital assistant. The app is powered by Meta’s Muse Spark series of AI models and represents CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s major push into the AI‑agent market.

In terms of business model, Muse offers a free basic tier and two subscription plans at $20 and $100 per month, giving Meta a monetisation path for AI that is separate from its core online‑advertising business.

Meta enjoys a strong platform advantage for user acquisition. Apptopia data indicate that over 95% of Muse users are also Facebook users and 63% are Instagram users. Muse also integrates with WhatsApp, and Meta previously leveraged similar cross‑platform funneling to grow Threads to 500 million users, a path Muse hopes to replicate.

Muse’s rapid expansion has already caused noticeable friction in the e‑commerce ecosystem. Amazon announced it is blocking Muse’s access to its shopping site, citing privacy and security risks. Amazon said Meta did not inform it that Muse would access the platform, and noted the agent bypassed Amazon’s built‑in personalization features and appeared to capture and store user credentials and scrape account data.

An Amazon spokesperson said, “We believe third‑party apps that act on behalf of customers to purchase from other merchants should be transparent and respect the service provider’s decision on participation.”

In contrast, Shopify chose to partner with Meta. Shopify CEO Tobias Lütke announced on Monday that Shopify will work with Muse to enable agent‑checkout functionality within its storefronts, providing a key endorsement for Muse’s rollout in e‑commerce scenarios.

Although Muse got off to a strong start, doubts remain about its ability to sustain momentum. Previously, OpenAI’s Sora and Meta’s own Vibes AI video tool both generated download spikes at launch but failed to become lasting phenomena.

At the same time, Muse’s rise occurs amid broader industry pressures. Concerns over AI safety and cybersecurity have been weighing on the tech sector, and Meta itself has just agreed to pay roughly $17 billion to settle claims with multiple state attorneys general over alleged harms to children and teens from Facebook and Instagram.

Muse’s heavy reliance on users’ personal data also raises concerns. Stacy Rasgon noted, “Users care about security, but I’m not sure how much they care about privacy.” This issue could become a long‑term risk for Muse’s development.

items.title: 80GB砍到1.7GB！AMD自研光追技術：顯示記憶體需求暴降47倍
items.title_en: 80GB Cut to 1.7GB! AMD’s Self‑Developed Ray‑Tracing Technology Slashes Video‑Memory Demand by 47‑Fold
paras: AMD(AMD-US)近日公佈了一項名為「四面體外籠」(Tetrahedral Cages)的革命性光線追蹤研究成果，在Radeon RX 9070 XT顯示記憶體的實測中，該技術將大規模場景的光追顯示記憶體佔用從80GB降低至1.7GB，縮減幅度高達97.8%。
AMD院士Holger Gruen表示，這項技術主要針對光追渲染中的BVH開銷問題，在傳統方案中，如果場景內有大量獨立運動的物體，GPU必須為每個物體維護並實時更新BVH結構。
而當場景複雜度達到上億個三角形時，高昂的更新成本和顯存佔用往往會導致顯卡不堪重負甚至「死機」。
此次AMD的新方案則採用了一種動靜分離的思路，將密集幾何體封裝在簡單的Tetrahedral Cages中，開發者只需要讓外層的籠子動起來，內部的高密度模型及其BVH結構可以保持靜態並重復使用。
在射線求交測試前，系統會將射線變換回原始坐標系，這種方法規避了對數億個頂點進行實時更新的計算壓力。
數據對比顯示，在包含2.5萬棵動態植被的測試場景中，傳統方案的BVH更新時間超過300毫秒，而新技術僅需3.3毫秒，效率提升了90倍以上。
同時顯存佔用也從足以撐爆頂級顯卡的80GB，優化到了僅需1.7GB，在處理包含5億個動態三角形的複雜場景時，RX 9070 XT在1080p分辨率下跑出了60 FPS以上的穩定幀率。
但該技術也並非全能，其主要適用於草地、森林、人群或遠景角色等密集場景，而且由於犧牲了對單個頂點動畫的精細控制，它無法勝任需要精確形變或拓撲結構(Topology Structure)變化的複雜動畫。
目前該研究已獲得High-Performance Graphics 2026三等獎，AMD正計劃推出相應的C++庫和DXR接口示例，但具體何時能在實際遊戲中推出尚無明確時間表。
paras_en: AMD (AMD‑US) recently announced a revolutionary ray‑tracing research result called “Tetrahedral Cages.” In real‑world testing on the Radeon RX 9070 XT’s video memory, the technique reduced the memory needed for ray‑traced rendering of large scenes from 80 GB to 1.7 GB, a reduction of 97.8 %.

AMD fellow Holger Gruen explained that the technology mainly addresses the BVH overhead in ray‑tracing rendering. In traditional approaches, when a scene contains many independently moving objects, the GPU must maintain and update a BVH structure for each object in real time.
When scene complexity reaches hundreds of millions of triangles, the high update cost and video‑memory consumption often overwhelm the graphics card, causing it to stall or even crash.

AMD’s new solution adopts a dynamic‑static separation concept, encapsulating dense geometry inside simple Tetrahedral Cages. Developers only need to animate the outer cages, while the high‑density models and their BVH structures inside remain static and can be reused.
Before ray‑intersection tests, the system transforms rays back to the original coordinate space, avoiding the computational pressure of updating hundreds of millions of vertices in real time.

Benchmark data shows that in a test scene with 25,000 dynamic plants, the BVH update time for the traditional method exceeds 300 ms, whereas the new technique requires only 3.3 ms, delivering more than a 90‑fold efficiency gain.

Video‑memory usage also dropped from a staggering 80 GB—enough to blow out even top‑tier GPUs—to just 1.7 GB. When handling a complex scene with 500 million dynamic triangles, the RX 9070 XT achieved a stable frame rate above 60 FPS at 1080p resolution.

The technique, however, is not universal. It is best suited for dense environments such as grasslands, forests, crowds, or distant characters, and because it sacrifices fine‑grained control of per‑vertex animation, it cannot handle complex animations that require precise deformation or topology changes.

The research has already earned a third‑place award at High‑Performance Graphics 2026. AMD plans to release a corresponding C++ library and DXR interface samples, but no concrete timeline has been announced for integration into actual games.

items.title: Muse登蘋果應用商店榜首 Meta股價應聲暴漲13%
items.title_en: Muse Tops Apple App Store, Meta Shares Surge 13%
paras: Meta(META-US) 旗下全新AI助手Muse迅速攀升至美國蘋果和Google應用商店免費榜榜首，初步數據顯示其下載量已超越前代產品。
分析師認為，這一成績是Meta數千億美元AI投資開始兌現的切實信號，並可能為Meta打開廣告、訂閱及交易分成等全新變現空間。
Evercore ISI分析師Mark Mahaney周一在研究報告中寫道，Meta手中握有Muse這張王牌，這是產品創新成功的切實體現，也證明Meta累計約2,000億美元的AI投入並非徒勞。
市場調查機構Sensor Tower資深分析師Abe Yousef指出，Muse於9月8日上線，此後六天內下載量超過90.2萬次，高於前代Meta AI應用同期77.3萬次的成績。
與舊版產品相比，Muse支援基於用戶社交內容進行個性化回應，並可接入Gmail、日曆、OpenTable等第三方服務，功能層級顯著提升。
上述消息提振Meta股價周一（21日）盤中一度飆漲13%，最終收漲11%，創下2025年4月以來最大單日漲幅。
漲勢亦蔓延至Meta核心供應商，AMD(AMD-US) 收漲9.9%，市值首次收於1兆美元整數位心理關口上方；英特爾(INTC-US) 收漲12%，寫下5月以來最大單日漲幅。
paras_en: Meta's (META-US) brand‑new AI assistant Muse quickly rose to the top of the free charts in both Apple's and Google's app stores in the United States, and early data show its download count has already surpassed that of the previous generation product.

Analysts say this achievement is a tangible signal that Meta's multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar AI investment is beginning to pay off, and could open up new monetization avenues for Meta such as advertising, subscriptions, and transaction revenue sharing.

Evercore ISI analyst Mark Mahaney wrote in a Monday research note that Meta now holds Muse as a trump card, a concrete demonstration of successful product innovation, and proof that Meta's roughly $200 billion AI spend has not been in vain.

Senior analyst Abe Yousef of market‑research firm Sensor Tower noted that Muse launched on September 8, and within six days amassed more than 902,000 downloads, exceeding the 773,000 downloads recorded over the same period for the previous Meta AI app.

Compared with the older version, Muse supports personalized responses based on users' social content and can integrate third‑party services such as Gmail, Calendar, and OpenTable, representing a significant upgrade in functionality.
The news lifted Meta's stock on Monday (the 21st), sending it soaring as much as 13% intraday and closing up 11%, the biggest single‑day gain since April 2025.

The rally also spread to Meta's core suppliers, with AMD (AMD-US) rising 9.9% to close above the psychological $1 trillion market‑cap threshold, and Intel (INTC-US) gaining 12%, its largest single‑day rise since May.

items.title: Meta股價單月大漲近三成 AI助理Muse登上美國App Store榜首
items.title_en: Meta Shares Surge Nearly 30% in a Month as AI Assistant Muse Tops US App Store
paras: Meta(META-US)股價周一(21日)大漲11.4%，收在2025年10月以來最高水準，並創下2025年4月以來最大單日漲幅，新推出的個人AI助理Muse近期登上蘋果(AAPL-US)美國App Store排行榜第一名，是帶動漲勢的主因。
Muse的熱潮，推動Meta股價朝13年多來最佳單月表現邁進，該股本月以來已上漲29.5%，距離今年3月出現的52周低點也反彈逾40%。當時股價低迷，反映投資人被Meta提高2026年AI資本支出嚇壞了。
隨著Muse問世，投資人開始更清楚看到執行長祖克伯(Mark Zuckerberg)將公司追求的AI策略定位：「個人超級智慧」(personal superintelligence)，也就是能深入了解使用者，並高度客製化的技術。

Muse可執行多步驟任務 AI變現前景受關注

Muse於9月8日推出，專長是執行多步驟任務，例如從不同帳戶尋找資料、填寫網路表單，以及協商並完成線上購物。使用者可以透過Muse應用程式或WhatsApp向AI代理程式下達指令。
Muse基本版免費提供給使用者，另外還有每月20美元及100美元的付費方案。
Meta今年資本支出預估將達1300-1450億美元，主要用於資料中心等實體資產。儘管Meta傳統廣告業務仍在快速成長，投資人一直無法確定該公司能靠AI開創新的營收來源，如今Muse取得成功，逐步緩解市場對Meta支出的疑慮，也讓投資人更相信其所制定的AI變現策略。
華爾街也對Meta近期推出的Meta Model API感到興趣。這是Meta首次向開發商及企業用戶收費，讓他們存取Meta底層AI模型。

AI代理普及仍有障礙 亞馬遜封鎖Muse購物

不過，AI代理程式要廣泛普及仍面臨挑戰，尤其是在不同平台執行任務時可能遭遇限制：亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周末便封鎖Muse在其網站上的購物功能，理由是Muse違反亞馬遜使用條款，並涉及安全疑慮。
Pivotal Research Group分析師Jeff Wlodarczak周一說：「我們認為，隨著代理型AI日益取代人類的搜尋、比價及例行決策，這種壓力可能會擴大。」
Wlodarczak補充，AI代理程式若廣泛使用，可能重創數位廣告業務，進而促使亞馬遜等公司採取行動，並自行開發第一方AI代理程式。
Meta周三舉行的Meta Connect大會，也可能成為推動股價的另一項催化劑，屆時Meta將公布新的AI產品及相關進展。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) shares jumped 11.4% on Monday (the 21st), closing at the highest level since October 2025 and marking the biggest single‑day gain since April 2025. The recent rise to the top of Apple’s (AAPL-US) US App Store chart by its newly launched personal AI assistant Muse was the main driver of the rally.

The Muse hype is pushing Meta’s stock toward its best monthly performance in over 13 years, with the share up 29.5% so far this month and rebounding more than 40% from the 52‑week low hit in March. The stock had been depressed then, reflecting investors’ fear of Meta’s increased AI capital spending for 2026.

With Muse’s debut, investors are seeing more clearly CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s AI strategy, which he frames as “personal superintelligence” – technology that deeply understands users and delivers highly customized experiences.

Muse, launched on September 8, excels at multi‑step tasks such as pulling data from different accounts, filling online forms, and negotiating and completing e‑commerce purchases. Users can issue commands to the AI agent via the Muse app or WhatsApp.
A basic version of Muse is offered for free, with additional paid tiers at $20 and $100 per month.

Meta’s capital expenditures this year are projected at $130‑$145 billion, mainly for data‑center and other physical assets. Although Meta’s traditional advertising business continues to grow rapidly, investors have been unsure whether the company can generate new revenue streams from AI. Muse’s success is gradually easing market concerns about Meta’s spending and bolstering confidence in its AI monetisation roadmap.
Wall Street is also taking interest in Meta’s newly introduced Meta Model API, the first time Meta will charge developers and enterprise customers for access to its underlying AI models.
AI agents still face adoption hurdles. Amazon (AMZN-US) blocked Muse’s shopping function on its site over the weekend, citing violations of Amazon’s terms of service and security concerns.

Pivotal Research Group analyst Jeff Wlodarczak said on Monday, “We believe that as agent‑type AI increasingly replaces humans for search, price‑comparison and routine decision‑making, this pressure could expand.”
Wlodarczak added that widespread use of AI agents could severely disrupt the digital advertising industry, prompting companies like Amazon to take action and develop their own first‑party AI agents.
Meta’s Connect conference on Wednesday could serve as another catalyst for the stock, as the company is set to unveil new AI products and related developments.

items.title: 環球時報：中美加強合作有利於世界 台灣問題牽一髮動全身
items.title_en: Global Times: Strengthened US‑China Cooperation Benefits the World, Taiwan Issue Can Trigger a Chain Reaction
paras: 應美國總統川普邀請，中國國家主席習近平將於9月23日至25日訪美，這項消息公布後，國際社會高度關注。
中國鷹派喉舌《環球時報》22日（周二）在社評中表示，作為世界上最重要的雙邊關係，中美關係的走向不僅關乎兩國人民福祉，也牽動世界格局穩定。世界高度期待中美發出致力於推進建設性戰略穩定關係、共促世界和平與發展的正面訊息。
《環球時報》稱，地球足夠大，容得下中美兩國共同發展、各自繁榮。當今世界還有很多難題，中國和美國可以共同展現大國擔當，攜手多辦一些有利於兩國和世界的大事、實事、好事。
《環球時報》提到，中美共同走出一條新時代大國正確相處之道，是雙方之所願，也是世界之所盼。期待在兩國元首共識引領下，雙方不斷豐富中美建設性戰略穩定關係新定位內涵，將其轉化為具體政策和實際舉措，共同開啟中美關係新篇章。
不過，《環球時報》也強調，中美關係仍面臨各種風險挑戰。最關鍵的就是美方是否能夠把兩國元首達成的共識落到實處，妥善管控分歧，解決實際問題。
《環球時報》說，在這當中，台灣問題是中美關係中最重要的問題，牽一髮而動全身。處理好了，兩國關係就能保持總體穩定，雙方就可以投入更多精力開展互利合作。處理不好，兩國就會碰撞甚至衝突，將整個中美關係推向十分危險的境地。
《環球時報》表示，美方只有恪守「一個中國」原則和中美三個聯合公報，履行應盡國際義務，將口頭承諾轉化為實際行動，不向「台獨」分裂勢力發出錯誤信號，才能真正維護中美關係穩定發展以及台海和平穩定。
paras_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit the United States from September 23 to 25. The announcement has drawn intense attention from the international community.

The hawkish Chinese outlet Global Times said on Tuesday, September 22, in an editorial that the trajectory of the U.S.–China relationship – the most important bilateral tie in the world – matters not only for the welfare of the two peoples but also for global stability. The world is eagerly awaiting a positive signal from both sides that they are committed to advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship and jointly promoting world peace and development.

The Global Times noted that the Earth is big enough to accommodate the joint development and separate prosperity of the United States and China. In a world still facing many challenges, the two powers can demonstrate great‑power responsibility by working together on more initiatives that benefit both countries and the world.

The paper added that forging a new, correct way for great powers to coexist in the new era is both a desire of the two sides and a hope of the world. It looks forward to the two heads of state’s consensus leading to a richer definition of a constructive, strategically stable U.S.–China relationship, turning that definition into concrete policies and actions and opening a new chapter in bilateral ties.

However, the Global Times also stressed that the U.S.–China relationship still faces a variety of risks and challenges. The most critical factor is whether the United States can translate the consensus reached by the two leaders into practice, manage differences prudently and solve concrete problems.

The outlet said that among all issues, Taiwan is the most important in the U.S.–China relationship – a single hair that can move the whole body. If handled well, overall stability can be maintained and both sides can devote more energy to mutually beneficial cooperation. If mishandled, the two countries could clash or even come into conflict, pushing the entire relationship into a very dangerous situation.

The Global Times argued that only if the United States strictly adheres to the One‑China principle and the three Sino‑U.S. joint communiqués, fulfills its international obligations, turns verbal commitments into concrete actions and does not send the wrong signal to Taiwan‑independence separatists, can it truly safeguard a stable U.S.–China relationship and peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

items.title: 告別「唯GPU論」！伺服器CPU成AI新瓶頸　部分型號今年已漲逾40%
items.title_en: Farewell to the “GPU‑Only” Theory! Server CPUs Become the New AI Bottleneck, Some Models Up Over 40% This Year
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，AI基礎設施缺貨潮從GPU、HBM蔓延至伺服器CPU，因供應持續緊張，英特爾與超微正與中國伺服器客戶簽訂更長期採購協議(LTA)，主要鎖定採購數量而非價格。部分產品今年以來漲幅已超過40%，個別型號更以每月逾10%的速度攀升。
《路透社》報導，這類協議期限約一至兩年，客戶提前承諾「買多少」以確保供應與交期。今年2月，兩家公司便已發出預警。AMD部分CPU交付週期達8至10週，英特爾最長達6個月。截至今年3月，伺服器廠商的平均交期從過去1至2週延長至8至12週以上。
缺貨主因在於AI算力需求從GPU向整體伺服器系統擴散。訓練階段雖靠GPU，但進入推理與Agentic AI階段後，CPU需承擔數據處理、資料庫查詢、任務編排及基礎設施管理等任務，成為擴張新瓶頸。
英特爾執行長陳立武表示，至強需求持續超過供應，首季已簽多項長期協議，包括與谷歌的多年合約。
超微半導體也看好市場，預估2030年伺服器CPU規模突破1200億美元，Agentic AI是關鍵推力。
研調機構TrendForce最新報告指出，伺服器CPU、記憶體、載板與電源等關鍵零件供應仍緊，產業正從「需求決定增長」轉向「供應決定能交付多少」，這意味著AI競賽進入新階段。過去搶GPU，如今CPU、記憶體、網通甚至電源都可能卡脖。
對英特爾與超微而言，這是久違的伺服器CPU景氣週期，CPU正重拾AI基礎設施關鍵地位。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the AI infrastructure shortage has spread from GPUs and HBM to server CPUs. Because supply remains tight, Intel and AMD are signing longer‑term purchase agreements (LTA) with Chinese server customers, focusing on quantity rather than price. Some products have risen over 40% year‑to‑date, with certain models climbing more than 10% per month.

Reuters reported that these agreements run about one to two years, with customers committing in advance how many they will buy to secure supply and delivery dates. In February this year, the two companies issued warnings. AMD’s certain CPUs have lead times of 8‑10 weeks, while Intel’s can be as long as six months. By March, the average lead time for server manufacturers had stretched from the usual 1‑2 weeks to over 8‑12 weeks.

The shortage stems from AI compute demand shifting from GPUs to the whole server system. Training relies on GPUs, but once inference and agentic AI phases begin, CPUs must handle data processing, database queries, task orchestration and infrastructure management, becoming the new expansion bottleneck.
Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said Xeon demand continues to outpace supply, and the company signed multiple long‑term deals in the first quarter, including a multi‑year contract with Google.
AMD also sees a bright market, forecasting that server CPU revenue will exceed $120 billion by 2030, with agentic AI as a key driver.

Research firm TrendForce’s latest report says supply of key parts such as server CPUs, memory, substrates and power supplies remains tight, and the industry is shifting from ‘demand‑driven growth’ to ‘supply‑determined delivery capacity,’ meaning the AI race has entered a new phase. In the past the scramble was for GPUs; now CPUs, memory, networking and even power supplies can become choke points.
For Intel and AMD, this marks a long‑awaited upturn in the server‑CPU cycle, with CPUs regaining their pivotal role in AI infrastructure.

items.title: Meta Muse帶旺CPU行情！AMD躋身兆美元俱樂部 英特爾、Arm跟著嗨
items.title_en: Meta Muse Boosts CPU Rally! AMD Joins the Trillion‑Dollar Club, Intel and Arm Follow Suit
paras: Meta平台(META-US) 推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也讓市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。
超微電腦(SMCI-US) 周一（21日）股價大漲近10%，收在615.52美元，市值首度突破1兆美元，成為繼輝達(NVDA-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 及美光科技(MU-US) 後，第4家跨越兆美元門檻的美國晶片公司。
AMD周一股價創6月30日以來收盤新高。自蘇姿丰2014年接掌公司以來，市值較2015年夏季低點翻逾370倍。
經歷前兩個月回檔後，AMD重新獲得投資人青睞，9月迄今上漲近30%，可望寫下5月以來最大單月漲幅。
這波漲勢的催化劑來自AI應用端。Meta於9月初推出Muse，可在後台代替使用者預訂旅行、管理行程及購物。
Sensor Tower數據顯示，Muse已連續3天位居美國iPhone免費App下載榜首，ChatGPT排名第2，Google Gemini居第8，Claude則降至第22。
Muse快速竄紅，使市場押注消費級智能體可能接近大規模普及的轉折點。隨著AI從問答走向實際操作，推論及基礎設施工作負載將增加，進而推升CPU需求。
Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6吉瓦的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1吉瓦部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。
樂觀情緒也蔓延至其他CPU概念股。英特爾(INTC-US) 周一大漲12.14%，Arm(ARM-US) 勁揚17.16%，高通上漲逾8%，Meta也飆升逾11%，創今年1月以來新高。

paras_en: Meta's consumer‑grade AI agent Muse, launched on the META‑US platform, quickly went viral, prompting the market to reassess the compute demand from widespread AI agents and lifting all CPU‑related stocks.

Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US) surged nearly 10% on Monday the 21st, closing at $615.52, and its market value broke the $1 trillion threshold for the first time, becoming the fourth U.S. chip company to cross that mark after Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

AMD’s share price hit a new closing high for the period since June 30 on Monday. Since Su Zifeng took the helm in 2014, the company’s market cap has multiplied more than 370 times from its summer‑2015 low.
After a pullback in the first two months, AMD has regained investor favor, up nearly 30% through September and poised to record its biggest monthly gain since May.
The catalyst for this rally comes from AI applications. Meta rolled out Muse in early September, allowing it to book travel, manage itineraries and shop on behalf of users in the background.
Sensor Tower data shows Muse has topped the U.S. iPhone free‑app download chart for three consecutive days, ranking ahead of ChatGPT (2nd), Google Gemini (8th) and Claude (down to 22nd).

Muse’s rapid rise has led the market to bet that consumer‑grade AI agents are nearing a mass‑adoption inflection point; as AI shifts from Q&A to real‑world tasks, inference and infrastructure workloads will grow, driving higher CPU demand.

Meta is currently AMD’s second‑largest customer, accounting for about 5.5% of revenue. The two firms announced an expanded partnership in February, with Meta planning to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, the first batch supporting 1 GW slated for shipment in the second half of 2026 and built on a custom chip based on the MI450 architecture.

Optimism spilled over to other CPU stocks. Intel (INTC‑US) jumped 12.14% on Monday, Arm (ARM‑US) surged 17.16%, Qualcomm rose over 8%, and Meta itself climbed more than 11%, hitting its highest level since January.

Industry players remain bullish on the server‑CPU market. Arm projects the market could reach $120 billion by 2030, AMD sees it topping $220 billion, and Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said last week the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand, with tight CPU supply expected to continue.

items.title: Muse超越ChatGPT登頂！Meta掀AI代理浪潮 超級App們準備投降？
items.title_en: Muse Surpasses ChatGPT to the Top! Meta Sparks AI Agent Wave—Will Super Apps Surrender?
paras: Meta(META-US) 個人AI助手Muse爆紅，誰又該要慌了？這背後代表著什麼趨勢，又有什麼機會？
具體來看，9 月 8 日發布的兩天後，Muse 在美國 App Store 的下載量就超過了 8 萬次，衝到總榜第二。第三方數據機構 Sensor Tower 統計則顯示，它上線第一週的下載量就接近 90 萬次。
又過了幾天，Muse 登上了美國 App Store 免費榜第一名，一度把 ChatGPT 擠下去。
但 Muse 值得關注的地方，是它「個人AI代理」的官方定位。也就是說，它並不是因為有多能聊天而受歡迎，是你交代一個目標，它能自己把事情辦完。
Muse 的登頂則表明，個人 AI代理正從產業概念真正走進大眾消費市場。這是一個非常強的早期信號，意味著大家願意把真實的任務交給 AI 去辦，有這個需求。
字節的豆包手機想讓 AI 像人一樣操作手機上的 App，替用戶把事辦成，結果卻卡在了超級 App 的權限限制上。這次，Muse 又走了另外一條路。那麼，超級 App 還能長期把 AI代理擋在門外？還是應該像 Meta 一樣，主動加入這場革命呢？
首先，Muse 的執行方式和手機廠商的做法不太一樣。豆包手機是讓 AI 去理解手機螢幕、操作一個個 App。但問題是，技術上能走通，商業上卻困難重重。
此外，蘋果、Google、小米等等各個公司也都給出了自己的解法。Muse 則是在雲端給每個用戶配了一台獨立的虛擬機，裡面有一個真正的瀏覽器，可以安全地儲存 AI代理的數據和已連接服務的憑證。
AI 就在這台雲端電腦裡完成瀏覽網頁、填寫表單、調用服務等各類任務。當涉及發送郵件或完成付款等敏感操作時，Muse 會先請求用戶批准。
當然，給 AI代理配一台雲端電腦，讓它自己在裡面完成任務，這件事本身並不新鮮。
此前，騰訊雲已經把雲桌面做成了 AI代理的運行基座，百度智慧雲也能一鍵部署 AI代理。OpenClaw、Hermes 這類 AI代理，早就能在雲端伺服器上長期運行。
Muse 只是把這件事工程化和產品化了，把過去只有極客、開發者尖端科技愛好者才願意費勁折騰的事情，打包成了普通消費者拿起手機就能用的產品。
這不是說它沒有技術含量。Meta 還需要在架構優化、安全隔離、敏感動作審批等方面花大量功夫，讓每個人都敢放心把真實任務交給 Muse 去做。
可見，豆包和 Muse，兩條路線沒有誰先進誰落後，但它們共同說明了一件事，即 AI代理這個潮流不會因為超級 App 的圍堵而停止。
原因也很簡單，AI代理不只有一種做法。手機跨 App 操作的這條路，可能容易被超級 App 通過權限的封鎖而堵住，但 AI代理還可以走網頁的路。
網頁和平台並不是不封網頁端的 AI代理。去年，亞馬遜就明確要求 Perplexity 的瀏覽器 AI代理 Comet，停止在亞馬遜的網站上代理購物。理由是第三方 AI代理會破壞亞馬遜為用戶提供的完整購物體驗。
就在封別人 AI代理的同時，亞馬遜卻在緊鑼密鼓地大力發展購物 AI代理。Buy for Me 功能，就是讓亞馬遜的 AI代理直接跑到其他品牌網站上替用戶下單，用戶在自己的亞馬遜帳號裡完成一整套購買流程。目前，該功能已經涵蓋了數千萬種商品。
因此，做 AI代理已經是共識，產業競爭的焦點只是誰能控制 AI代理入口。這點在 Meta 做 Muse 這件事上看得最清楚。
理論上，Muse 就是在革 Meta 的命。因為用戶習慣了 AI代理，就不再自己打開 App 去搜索、瀏覽和比較，而是會直接把目標告訴 AI，剩下的交給 AI 去處理。但這跟 Meta 賴以為生的廣告模式有直接衝突。人們都不點開 Meta 的 App 和網頁了，廣告給誰看呢？
可要知道，今天的 Meta 還高度依賴廣告。2026 年第二季度，他們的廣告收入為 593 億美元，佔總收入的 97%。也就是說，Meta 在舊模式還極其賺錢的時候，主動開啟了可能顛覆自己舊模式的個人 AI代理業務。
Meta 認定一場產業革命要來，就主動革了自己的命，不因為新模式可能損害舊利益，就拒絕進入，或是緩慢推進。而且，他們的轉型也並不是莽撞的行為。
Meta 手裡握著超 30 億的日活用戶，一旦通過這個基本盤佔住了個人AI代理這個新入口，也就將成為 AI代理時代最強的玩家之一。
AI代理真正會帶來的變化，就是超級App主導的產業格局終將被打破。超級 App 未必會消失，但它們將逐漸從第一入口，變成 AI代理背後的服務提供者。
未來用戶一定會越來越習慣先把需求交給 AI代理，再由 AI代理去尋找和調用服務。可以說，這是繼 iPhone之後，手機產業最令人興奮的趨勢，也是我們認為，所有開發者和創業者最應該參與的機會。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) personal AI assistant Muse has gone viral—who should be worried? What trend does this represent, and what opportunities does it bring?

Specifically, just two days after its September 8 launch, Muse topped 80,000 downloads on the US App Store, climbing to second place overall. Third‑party data firm Sensor Tower reports that its first week of availability drew nearly 900,000 downloads.
A few days later, Muse reached the number‑one spot on the US App Store free chart, briefly displacing ChatGPT.

What’s noteworthy about Muse is its official positioning as a “personal AI agent.” In other words, its popularity isn’t just because it can chat—it can be given a goal and complete the task on its own.

Muse’s ascent shows that personal AI agents are moving from an industry concept into the mass‑consumer market. This is a strong early signal that people are willing to hand real tasks over to AI, indicating genuine demand.

ByteDance’s Doubao phone aims to let AI operate apps on the phone like a human and complete tasks for users, but it’s stalled by super‑app permission limits. Muse, however, has taken a different route. So can super apps keep AI agents out in the long run, or should they, like Meta, join the revolution?
First, Muse’s execution differs from phone‑maker approaches. Doubao lets AI interpret the screen and manipulate each app, a technically feasible but commercially challenging method.

Moreover, Apple, Google, Xiaomi and others have each offered their own solutions. Muse instead provisions each user with a dedicated cloud VM that runs a real browser, safely storing the agent’s data and credentials for connected services.

The AI performs web browsing, form‑filling, service calls and other tasks inside that cloud computer. For sensitive actions such as sending email or making payments, Muse first asks the user for approval.
Providing an AI agent with its own cloud computer to carry out tasks isn’t a new idea in itself.

Previously, Tencent Cloud turned its cloud desktops into AI‑agent platforms, and Baidu Smart Cloud can deploy AI agents with a single click. Projects like OpenClaw and Hermes have long run AI agents on cloud servers.
Muse simply engineers and productizes this concept, turning what was once a niche, geek‑level undertaking into a consumer‑ready product you can use on a phone with a tap.

That doesn’t mean it lacks technical depth. Meta still has to invest heavily in architecture optimization, security isolation, and approval flows for sensitive actions so users feel comfortable entrusting real tasks to Muse.
Thus, Doubao and Muse follow different paths without one being inherently ahead, yet both demonstrate that the AI‑agent wave won’t be halted by super‑app gatekeeping.
The reason is simple: AI agents can be implemented in multiple ways. The cross‑app mobile route may be blocked by super‑app permission restrictions, but agents can also operate via the web.

Web‑based agents aren’t prohibited either. Last year Amazon explicitly told Perplexity’s browser AI agent Comet to stop acting as a shopping assistant on Amazon’s site, arguing third‑party agents undermine Amazon’s curated shopping experience.

At the same time Amazon is aggressively building its own shopping AI agents. Its “Buy for Me” feature lets Amazon’s AI place orders on other brands’ sites on behalf of users, completing the entire purchase within the user’s Amazon account. The feature now covers tens of millions of products.
Consequently, building AI agents has become a consensus, and industry competition now centers on who controls the entry point for those agents—a point made crystal clear by Meta’s launch of Muse.

In theory, Muse could rewrite Meta’s destiny. As users grow accustomed to AI agents, they’ll stop opening apps to search, browse and compare, instead telling the AI what they want and letting it handle the rest. That directly conflicts with Meta’s ad‑driven business model—if people no longer open Meta’s apps or sites, who sees the ads?

It’s worth noting that Meta remains heavily ad‑dependent today. In Q2 2026, its ad revenue was $59.3 billion, accounting for 97% of total revenue. In other words, while its legacy model is still extremely profitable, Meta has proactively launched a personal AI‑agent business that could disrupt that very model.

Meta believes an industry revolution is coming, so it’s reshaping its own fate rather than shying away from a new model that might erode existing profits or moving slowly. Moreover, its transformation isn’t reckless.
Meta controls over 3 billion daily active users; once it secures the personal AI‑agent entry point with that base, it will become one of the strongest players in the AI‑agent era.

The real impact of AI agents will be to break the super‑app‑dominated industry structure. Super apps may not disappear, but they will shift from being the primary entry point to becoming service providers behind AI agents.

In the future, users will increasingly hand their needs to AI agents first, which will then locate and invoke the appropriate services. This can be seen as the most exciting post‑iPhone trend in the mobile industry—and, in our view, the biggest opportunity for developers and entrepreneurs.

items.title: 美國期中選舉將近！川普今年來點名批評拜登890次 單日最多16次
items.title_en: US Midterms Approaching! Trump Has Named and Criticized Biden 890 Times This Year, Up to 16 Times in a Single Day
paras: 美國期中選舉將近，共和黨力爭保住國會控制權，已淡出公眾視野的民主黨前總統拜登，依舊是現任總統川普最愛攻擊的目標。
《路透社》21日（周一）發布的調查數據顯示，自今年1月1日以來，川普在各類演講、評論和社媒貼文中至少點名指責拜登890次，平均每天3次，話題涉及通膨、移民到彈藥短缺。
數據顯示，川普至少在經濟問題上210次提到拜登，移民問題168次，外交政策和國家安全事務138次，同時還將一系列其他國內問題也歸咎於拜登。
今年7月北約（NATO）峰會期間，川普曾在一天內提及拜登多達16次，創下最高紀錄，指責理由包括軍事彈藥短缺、住宅成本等。
美國現任總統攻擊前任很常見，拜登也曾指責過川普。但像川普這樣在第二任期已過20個月仍持續點名批評拜登，格外引人關注。
2020年總統大選中拜登戰勝川普，川普對此耿耿於懷，多次宣稱那場選舉遭到「竊取」。目前拜登基本上已退出公共生活。
隨著川普支持率下滑、與伊朗戰爭拖延不決、美國生活成本居高不下，他在今年的選舉周期中努力聚焦拜登，「試圖讓美國人繼續關注前朝失敗，而不是選民對他自己總統任期的擔憂」。
paras_en: With the US midterm elections looming and Republicans fighting to retain control of Congress, former Democratic President Joe Biden—who has faded from the public eye—remains the favorite target of incumbent President Donald Trump.

Reuters reported on Monday the 21st that, since January 1 of this year, Trump has mentioned and attacked Biden at least 890 times across speeches, comments and social‑media posts, averaging three times per day, covering topics such as inflation, immigration and ammunition shortages.

The data show that Trump referenced Biden at least 210 times on economic issues, 168 times on immigration, 138 times on foreign policy and national security, and also blamed the former president for a range of other domestic problems.
During the NATO summit in July, Trump mentioned Biden as many as 16 times in a single day, setting a record and accusing him of everything from military ammunition shortages to rising housing costs.

It is common for a sitting US president to attack a predecessor, and Biden has also criticized Trump, but Trump’s continued, daily naming‑and‑shaming of Biden more than 20 months into his second term has drawn particular attention.

Biden defeated Trump in the 2020 presidential election, a loss that Trump still harbors resentment over, repeatedly claiming the election was "stolen"; Biden has largely withdrawn from public life since then.

As Trump’s approval rating slips, the war with Iran drags on, and the cost of living remains high, he is focusing his 2024 campaign on Biden, "trying to keep Americans fixated on the previous administration’s failures rather than on concerns about his own tenure as president."

市場之所以將Muse的走紅與AMD連結, 關鍵在於AI代理人的運作方式。AI代理人在執行任務時, 除了需要AI加速器處理模型推論, 還需要大量中央處理器(CPU)負責工具呼叫、任務協調以及不同模型運算之間的流程控制。AMD長期布局的EPYC伺服器CPU因此可能從AI代理人需求擴張中受益。
AMD執行長蘇姿丰在第2季財報電話會議上表示, 公司目前預期伺服器CPU市場到2030年將以超過50%的速度成長, 總可服務市場(TAM)約達2,200億美元。她並指出, 在這2,200億美元市場中, agentic AI或AI sandbox將成為最大的一部分, 同時也是成長速度最快、目前規模最小的部分。
AMD第2季業績也為市場重新評估CPU在AI基礎設施中的角色提供支撐。截至6月27日的第2季, AMD營收年增50%至115億美元, 非GAAP稀釋後每股盈餘則年增246%至1.66美元。資料中心營收更年增107%, 達67億美元, 超過1年前的1倍。
AMD也同步提高對資料中心市場的預期。公司目前預估, 資料中心AI加速器市場到2030年將以超過45%的年增率擴張至約1.4兆美元, 而伺服器CPU市場則預估以超過50%的年增率成長至約2,200億美元。公司並預期2026年下半年伺服器營收將年增超過80%, 2027年全年則將年增超過70%; 資料中心部門2027年營收則預期將超過2026年的2倍。
除了AMD之外, AI代理人帶動的CPU需求預期也推升其他晶片股。Arm Holdings (ARM-US)21日股價大漲約17%, Intel (INTC-US)上漲約12%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US)上漲約9%, VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US)則上漲約4.3%。Reuters指出, 晶片股大漲也推動費城半導體指數上升4.3%。
Intel的漲勢尤其受到市場對伺服器CPU需求升溫的預期帶動。市場對AI基礎設施的關注過去主要集中在GPU及其他AI加速器, 但AI代理人需要大量CPU處理周邊工作, 使投資人重新關注CPU在下一階段AI運算架構中的角色。
Meta本身也是AMD的重要客戶。兩家公司今年2月擴大合作, 規劃在Meta的資料中心基礎設施中部署AMD的AI晶片, 涵蓋最高6GW的電力容量。這意味著Muse帶動的AI代理人需求, 不只是市場對AMD長期CPU市場預測的抽象想像, AMD與Meta之間本身已存在直接的商業合作關係。
Meta股價同樣受到Muse市場反應帶動。Meta 21日收於741.25美元, 上漲75.50美元或11.34%, 盤中一度升至753美元, 市值達約1.89兆美元。Reuters指出, Meta股價大漲同時受到市場對Muse的樂觀情緒以及券商調升目標價等因素推動。
AI代理人能否真正帶動CPU需求, 仍取決於未來企業與消費者的實際使用方式。AI代理人需要持續執行任務, 因此會增加CPU負載, 但模型推論本身仍高度依賴GPU等AI加速器, 實際增加多少CPU需求也會受到資料中心架構、工作負載配置及運算效率影響。因此,Muse登上App Store榜首目前更適合作為消費端AI代理人開始獲得大規模採用的市場訊號, 而非直接等同於AMD未來營收的增加。
不過, Muse的下載排名仍提供了一項此前較少見的消費端數據。AMD過去提出的AI代理人市場論述主要建立在企業及資料中心工作負載預期之上, 如今Meta的AI代理人進入美國iPhone免費App下載榜首, 顯示AI代理人開始從企業工具擴展至一般消費者市場。市場因此重新評估CPU在AI產業下一階段成長中的角色。
在更廣泛的市場層面, AI題材也重新推動科技股走高。Nasdaq綜合指數21日上漲逾2%, 創下自6月以來首個歷史收盤新高; S&P 500上漲1.49%, 道瓊工業指數上漲0.71%。AI相關晶片股成為盤面主要推動力量之一。
AMD突破1兆美元市值, 也代表市場對AI基礎設施的投資邏輯正在從單純追逐AI加速器, 擴大至CPU、記憶體、網路及其他資料中心零組件。隨著AI代理人需要持續執行更多複雜任務, CPU能否成為下一階段AI基礎設施需求的重要受益者, 將成為晶片產業接下來的重要觀察焦點。
paras_en: Meta Platforms (META-US) AI agent Muse has risen to the top of the free‑app download chart on Apple’s (AAPL-US) US App Store, prompting the market to view the rapid consumer‑side adoption of this AI agent as a new signal that demand for AI agents – and consequently server CPU demand – could expand, sending Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) shares up 9.9% on the 21st and pushing its market value past the $1 trillion mark for the first time.

AMD closed the day at $615.52, up $55.70 or 9.95%, briefly hitting a historic intraday high of $616.69. Based on the company’s latest reported share count, AMD’s market cap has broken the $1 trillion threshold, making it the fourth U.S. chip firm to reach that level after NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and Micron Technology (MU‑US).

The immediate catalyst for the rally is Muse. Sensor Tower data show that Muse has been the most downloaded free iPhone app in the United States for three consecutive days. Unlike traditional chatbots that mainly answer questions, AI agents can follow user commands to perform multi‑step tasks such as browsing the web, processing data, running programs and other workloads that require continuous computation.

The market links Muse’s popularity to AMD because of how AI agents operate. When an AI agent runs a task it not only needs an AI accelerator for model inference, but also a large amount of central processing unit (CPU) power to handle tool calls, task coordination and flow control between different model computations. AMD’s long‑standing EPYC server CPUs could therefore benefit from expanding AI‑agent demand.

AMD CEO Dr. Lisa Su said in the Q2 earnings call that the company now expects the server‑CPU market to grow at a rate of more than 50% through 2030, with a total addressable market of roughly $220 billion. She noted that within that $220 billion market, agentic AI or AI sandboxes will become the largest segment, as well as the fastest‑growing and currently smallest portion.

AMD’s Q2 results also gave the market fresh support for reassessing the role of CPUs in AI infrastructure. For the quarter ended June 27, AMD’s revenue rose 50% year‑over‑year to $11.5 billion, and non‑GAAP diluted EPS jumped 246% to $1.66. Data‑center revenue surged 107% year‑over‑year to $6.7 billion, more than double the level a year earlier.

AMD also raised its outlook for the data‑center market. The company now projects the AI‑accelerator market for data centers to expand at a compound annual growth rate of over 45% to about $1.4 trillion by 2030, while the server‑CPU market is expected to grow at over 50% CAGR to roughly $220 billion. AMD foresees server revenue growing more than 80% year‑over‑year in the second half of 2026 and more than 70% for all of 2027; data‑center revenue in 2027 is expected to exceed 2026’s level by more than double.

Beyond AMD, the CPU demand driven by AI agents is also lifting other chip stocks. Arm Holdings (ARM‑US) jumped about 17% on the 21st, Intel (INTC‑US) rose roughly 12%, Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) about 9% and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) about 4.3%. Reuters noted that the broad rally in chip stocks pushed the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 4.3%.

Intel’s gains were especially fueled by market expectations of hotter server‑CPU demand. While attention to AI infrastructure has traditionally focused on GPUs and other accelerators, AI agents require substantial CPU work for peripheral tasks, prompting investors to re‑evaluate the CPU’s role in the next‑generation AI compute stack.

Meta itself is an important AMD customer. The two companies expanded their partnership in February, planning to deploy AMD AI chips in Meta’s data‑center infrastructure with up to 6 GW of power capacity. This means that the demand for AI agents spurred by Muse is not just an abstract long‑term CPU forecast – there is already a direct commercial relationship between AMD and Meta.

Meta’s stock also reacted to the Muse buzz. Meta closed on the 21st at $741.25, up $75.50 or 11.34%, briefly reaching $753 intraday, giving it a market cap of about $1.89 trillion. Reuters said the surge was driven by optimism around Muse as well as broker upgrades to price targets.

Whether AI agents can truly drive CPU demand will depend on how enterprises and consumers actually use them. Agents run continuously, which adds CPU load, but model inference still heavily relies on GPUs and other accelerators. The net increase in CPU demand will vary with data‑center architecture, workload mix and compute efficiency. Thus, Muse’s topping the App Store is currently a better signal that consumer‑side AI agents are beginning to achieve mass adoption, rather than a direct proxy for AMD’s future revenue growth.

Nevertheless, Muse’s download ranking provides a rare consumer‑side data point. AMD’s earlier AI‑agent market thesis was built mainly on enterprise and data‑center workload expectations; now that Meta’s AI agent has reached the top of the U.S. iPhone free‑app chart, it shows agents are moving from enterprise tools into the broader consumer market, prompting a reassessment of the CPU’s role in the next phase of AI industry growth.

On a broader market level, AI themes are once again lifting tech stocks. The Nasdaq Composite rose more than 2% on the 21st, hitting its first closing high since June, while the S&P 500 gained 1.49% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.71%. AI‑related chip stocks were among the main drivers of the rally.

AMD’s breach of the $1 trillion market‑cap mark also reflects a shift in investment logic for AI infrastructure, expanding from a sole focus on AI accelerators to include CPUs, memory, networking and other data‑center components. As AI agents require more continuous, complex task execution, whether CPUs become a major beneficiary of the next wave of AI infrastructure demand will be a key focus for the chip industry going forward.

items.title: AI「殺手級應用」出現了？Meta Muse快速爆紅 亞馬遜為何封鎖？
items.title_en: Has a "killer" AI application finally emerged? Meta's Muse skyrockets while Amazon blocks it
paras: Meta(META-US)旗下AI智慧代理應用Muse上線不到兩週，已在下載量和日活用戶數兩項關鍵指標上超越ChatGPT同期表現，引發市場對AI代理能否真正走向大眾的強烈期待。
Muse上線僅約五天便錄得73萬次下載，累計下載量在12天內突破280萬次，並於上週五登頂美國iOS免費應用榜首，超越ChatGPT、Anthropic的Claude及SpaceX AI旗下的Grok。受此提振，Meta股價週一單日飆漲逾11%，富國銀行隨即將其目標價上調至796美元。
市場分析人士認為，Muse的爆發式增長標誌著AI代理應用正從開發者和技術愛好者群體向普通消費者加速滲透。據CNBC報導，Bernstein分析師Stacy Rasgon表示：「到目前為止，大多數代理類應用場景並非真正面向普通人。現在Meta Muse等代理應用開始出現，或許正在獲得更廣泛普及的潛力。」
據TechCrunch報導，市場情報機構Apptopia的數據顯示，在可進行同口徑比較的美國和加拿大市場，Muse上線首12天的iOS下載量達180萬次，高於ChatGPT同期的130萬次。
另一家分析機構Sensor Tower數據則顯示，Muse在上線約五天內錄得73萬次下載，截至週一累計下載量已超過250萬次，其中iOS和Android平台分別貢獻約150萬次和,110萬次。
相比之下，Claude和Grok在同等13天窗口期內的下載量分別為40萬次和20萬次。ChatGPT在同一時間窗口內錄得310萬次下載，仍領先於Muse，但需注意兩款應用的平台發布策略存在差異——ChatGPT當年僅在iOS全球上線，而Muse目前僅在美國和加拿大的iOS及Android雙平台發布。
日活用戶數據同樣亮眼。Apptopia數據顯示，Muse的美國移動端日活用戶已達64.2萬，遠高於ChatGPT同期的23.1萬；即便僅比較iOS平台，Muse的日活用戶也以35.9萬對ChatGPT形成超越。
Meta將Muse定位為面向普通消費者的AI智慧代理工具，核心功能包括跨網絡執行任務，如填寫電子表單、整理電子郵件收件箱等，旨在讓用戶能夠管理和調度功能強大的數字助手。該應用由Meta的Muse Spark系列AI模型驅動，是首席執行官扎克伯格大舉進軍AI代理市場的重要舉措。
在商業模式上，Muse提供免費基礎版，同時設有每月20美元和100美元兩檔訂閱方案，為Meta開闢了一條有別於核心在線廣告業務的AI變現路徑。
Meta在用戶導流方面具備顯著的平台優勢。據Apptopia數據，Muse用戶中逾95%同時是Facebook用戶，63%是Instagram用戶。Muse還支持與WhatsApp打通，Meta此前憑藉類似的跨平台導流策略將Threads推向5億用戶規模，Muse有望複製這路徑。
Muse的快速擴張已在電商領域引發明顯的生態摩擦。亞馬遜宣布封鎖Muse對其購物網站的訪問，理由是隱私和安全風險。亞馬遜方面表示，Meta事先未告知Muse將訪問其平台，並指出該代理繞過了亞馬遜購物體驗中內置的個性化功能，且疑似捕獲並記憶體用戶憑證、抓取帳戶數據。
亞馬遜發言人在聲明中表示，「我們認為，代表客戶在其他商家處進行購買的第三方應用，應當公開透明進行，並尊重服務提供商關於是否參與的決定。」
與此形成對比的是，Shopify選擇與Meta合作。Shopify執行長Tobias Lütke週一宣布，Shopify將與Muse合作，允許其在平台商店內實現代理結帳功能，雙方的合作為Muse在電商場景的落地提供了重要背書。
儘管Muse開局強勁，但市場對其能否維持熱度仍存疑慮。此前，OpenAI的Sora以及Meta自身的Vibes AI視頻工具均曾在發布初期引發下載熱潮，但未能持續成為現象級產品。
同時，Muse的崛起也面臨更廣泛的行業背景壓力。AI安全與網絡安全風險的擔憂近期持續困擾科技行業，而Meta本身也剛剛同意支付約170億美元，與多個州檢察長就Facebook和Instagram對兒童及青少年造成潛在傷害的指控達成和解。
Muse對用戶個人數據的高度依賴同樣引發關注。Stacy Rasgon指出：「他們（用戶）在意安全，但我不確定他們有多在意隱私。」這一問題或將成為Muse長期發展的潛在隱患。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) launched its AI smart agent app Muse less than two weeks ago, and it has already surpassed ChatGPT’s performance at the same stage in both download volume and daily active users, sparking strong market expectations about whether AI agents can truly go mainstream.

Within about five days of launch, Muse recorded 730,000 downloads, and its cumulative downloads topped 2.8 million within 12 days, reaching the top of the U.S. iOS free‑app chart last Friday, ahead of ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude and SpaceX AI’s Grok. Boosted by this, Meta’s stock surged more than 11% on Monday, and Wells Fargo immediately raised its target price to $796.

Market analysts say Muse’s explosive growth marks AI agents moving from developers and tech enthusiasts to ordinary consumers. According to CNBC, Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon said, “So far most agent‑type use cases haven’t really been aimed at the average person. Now apps like Meta Muse are appearing and may have broader adoption potential.”

TechCrunch reported that market‑intelligence firm Apptopia’s data show that in the comparable U.S. and Canada markets, Muse’s iOS downloads in its first 12 days reached 1.8 million, higher than ChatGPT’s 1.3 million in the same period.

Data from another analytics firm, Sensor Tower, show that Muse logged 730,000 downloads in roughly five days after launch and had exceeded 2.5 million cumulative downloads by Monday, with about 1.5 million on iOS and 1.1 million on Android.

By contrast, Claude and Grok recorded 400,000 and 200,000 downloads respectively over the same 13‑day window. ChatGPT logged 3.1 million downloads in that period, still ahead of Muse, but note the platforms differ—ChatGPT was only on iOS globally at the time, whereas Muse is currently released on both iOS and Android in the U.S. and Canada.

Daily active user numbers are equally impressive. Apptopia data show Muse’s U.S. mobile daily active users reached 642,000, far above ChatGPT’s 231,000 in the same timeframe; even on iOS alone, Muse’s daily active users of 359,000 outpaced ChatGPT.

Meta positions Muse as an AI smart‑agent tool for everyday consumers, with core functions that execute cross‑network tasks such as filling out online forms and organizing email inboxes, aiming to let users manage and schedule a powerful digital assistant. The app is powered by Meta’s Muse Spark series of AI models and represents CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s major push into the AI‑agent market.

In terms of business model, Muse offers a free basic tier and two subscription plans at $20 and $100 per month, giving Meta a monetisation path for AI that is separate from its core online‑advertising business.

Meta enjoys a strong platform advantage for user acquisition. Apptopia data indicate that over 95% of Muse users are also Facebook users and 63% are Instagram users. Muse also integrates with WhatsApp, and Meta previously leveraged similar cross‑platform funneling to grow Threads to 500 million users, a path Muse hopes to replicate.

Muse’s rapid expansion has already caused noticeable friction in the e‑commerce ecosystem. Amazon announced it is blocking Muse’s access to its shopping site, citing privacy and security risks. Amazon said Meta did not inform it that Muse would access the platform, and noted the agent bypassed Amazon’s built‑in personalization features and appeared to capture and store user credentials and scrape account data.

An Amazon spokesperson said, “We believe third‑party apps that act on behalf of customers to purchase from other merchants should be transparent and respect the service provider’s decision on participation.”

In contrast, Shopify chose to partner with Meta. Shopify CEO Tobias Lütke announced on Monday that Shopify will work with Muse to enable agent‑checkout functionality within its storefronts, providing a key endorsement for Muse’s rollout in e‑commerce scenarios.

Although Muse got off to a strong start, doubts remain about its ability to sustain momentum. Previously, OpenAI’s Sora and Meta’s own Vibes AI video tool both generated download spikes at launch but failed to become lasting phenomena.

At the same time, Muse’s rise occurs amid broader industry pressures. Concerns over AI safety and cybersecurity have been weighing on the tech sector, and Meta itself has just agreed to pay roughly $17 billion to settle claims with multiple state attorneys general over alleged harms to children and teens from Facebook and Instagram.

Muse’s heavy reliance on users’ personal data also raises concerns. Stacy Rasgon noted, “Users care about security, but I’m not sure how much they care about privacy.” This issue could become a long‑term risk for Muse’s development.

items.title: DOCSIS 4.0升級需求回溫 Harmonic積壓訂單創高、Cable業者重啟資本支出
items.title_en: DOCSIS 4.0 Upgrade Demand Revives as Harmonic's Order Backlog Hits Record High and Cable Operators Restart Capex
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 北美有線寬頻(Cable)業者網路升級投資重新啟動。寬頻設備商Harmonic(HLIT-US)表示，2025年產業投資一度放緩，主要因Cable業者等待DOCSIS 4.0技術升級，但2026年相關網路現代化投資已開始回升，公司預估今年營收年增43%。
DOCSIS 4.0主要讓Cable業者利用既有HFC光纖同軸網路提升傳輸速度，不必全面改建光纖到府(FTTH)。Harmonic客戶Mediacom目前約有310萬戶家庭使用HFC網路，其中超過65萬戶已升級至對稱式多Gigabit服務，並部署超過700個完整DOCSIS 4.0節點，下行網路容量超過9 Gbps。
Harmonic指出，目前全球約有1.9億個Cable Modem，其中約4,800萬個已運行於公司cOS平台，仍有約75%的Cable Modem尚未轉向DAA分散式存取架構及虛擬化。公司預期DOCSIS市場投資將在2027至2028年達到高峰，之後則採較保守的持平假設。
不過，Cable業者並非全面採用DOCSIS 4.0，部分業者也選擇直接升級FTTH。Bluepeak表示，約80%至90%的既有HFC覆蓋區域將不再升級DOCSIS 4.0，而是直接鋪設光纖，預計未來3年完成約90%的既有HFC區域光纖覆蓋，顯示DOCSIS 4.0與FTTH正成為Cable業者兩條主要網路升級路線。
Harmonic表示，目前公司訂單積壓已創新高，並增加庫存採購，以確保供應並因應客戶需求。公司預估2026年至未來3年營收年複合成長率為10%至13%，其中DOCSIS市場在2027至2028年達高峰後，基本情境假設市場規模持平。

paras_en: September 22, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – North American cable broadband operators have resumed network upgrade investments. Broadband equipment maker Harmonic (HLIT-US) said that industry investment slowed in 2025 mainly because cable operators were waiting for the DOCSIS 4.0 technology upgrade, but modernization spending has started to pick up again in 2026, and the company forecasts a 43% year‑over‑year revenue increase this year.

DOCSIS 4.0 mainly allows cable operators to boost transmission speeds over existing HFC (hybrid fiber‑coaxial) networks without having to rebuild a full fiber‑to‑the‑home (FTTH) infrastructure. Harmonic’s customer Mediacom now serves roughly 3.1 million households on HFC, of which more than 650,000 have been upgraded to symmetric multi‑Gigabit service and over 700 complete DOCSIS 4.0 nodes have been deployed, delivering downstream capacity exceeding 9 Gbps.

Harmonic noted that there are about 190 million cable modems worldwide, with roughly 48 million already running on the company’s cOS platform. About 75% of cable modems have yet to transition to the DAA (distributed access architecture) and virtualization. The company expects DOCSIS market investment to peak in 2027‑2028 and then assume a more conservative flat‑line scenario.

However, cable operators are not adopting DOCSIS 4.0 across the board; some are opting to upgrade directly to FTTH. Bluepeak indicated that roughly 80%‑90% of existing HFC coverage areas will forgo further DOCSIS 4.0 upgrades and will instead be fiber‑laid, with a goal of completing fiber coverage for about 90% of current HFC zones within the next three years, showing that DOCSIS 4.0 and FTTH are becoming the two main upgrade paths for cable operators.

Harmonic said its order backlog has reached a new high and the company is increasing inventory purchases to secure supply and meet customer demand. paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
